whatHappens.title: What Happens After You Contact Us?
whatHappens.body: Your request is reviewed by a named case manager, who confirms the specification, checks sourcing and documentation against your destination market, and comes back with quantities, lead times, and supporting paperwork together.
whatHappens.guarantee: You will receive a direct response from a dedicated case manager within 24 hours.
